name: DUMBBELL FLY TO CLOSE GRIP PRESS
introduce:
Lie on a bench and hold a dumbbell in each hand. Extend your arms toward the ceiling with your palms facing each other. 

Lower your elbows to your sides until your upper arms are parallel to the floor, then push back to the starting position.

Press the dumbbells together, then lower them to your chest. Push the dumbbells back to the starting position again. Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please make sure your wrists are straight.
This exercise should be done slowly and in a controlled manner.
